name: Second Price Auction
summary: Auction where the highest bidder wins the object but pays only the second-highest bid amount.
rules_text: Each player has a private valuation for a single indivisible object. Simultaneously and secretly, each player submits a non-negative bid. The player with the highest bid wins the object. If there is a tie, the winner is chosen randomly among tied high bidders. The winner pays a price equal to the second-highest bid (or highest losing bid) and receives payoff equal to valuation minus price. All other players receive zero. Losing bids cost nothing. In procurement variant, lowest bid wins and is paid second-lowest bid.
rating_reason: Specific auction with second-price rule, fits engine
